description: Provide Posture, Dependencies, and (redacted) Secrets pages with severity grouping, last-scan time, and per-finding remediation.

requirements.title: Posture page
requirements.description: A landing Posture page must let the user pick a scenario and view findings grouped by severity (Critical -> Info) with per-finding remediation, last-scan time, and a re-scan button.

validation.notes: Findings render grouped by severity with stable data-testid selectors.
Selecting a scenario and pressing re-scan refreshes the finding list.

requirements.title: Dependencies and redacted Secrets pages
requirements.description: A Dependencies page must surface the searchable SBOM index (AI/TEXT toggle, ecosystem + vulnerable-only filters); a Secrets page must show gitleaks findings redacted to file:line only with rotation guidance.

validation.notes: The Dependencies page renders the vulnerable-only filter and ecosystem toggle.
The Secrets page never renders a raw secret value, only file:line and guidance.
